name: Broich y Ddinas
text: Broich y Ddinas is a Welsh place name. MacKillop directs the reader to the entry for Dinas Emrys. Dinas Emrys is the hilltop stronghold of Gwynedd. It is the site where the boy Merlin revealed the fighting dragons.
